title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli
description: Jungle Book Shōnen Mowgli is an anime adaptation of Rudyard Kipling’s original collection of stories, The Jungle Book. It aired in 1989, and consists of a total of 52 episodes.The series, a compromise between the original Mowgli stories and the Walt Disney version, received international acclaim and was aired in different countries around the world.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli Opening Song
The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x1
episodes_data.description: Mowgli, an orphaned infant who has wandered into the jungle, is adopted by two wolves.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x2
episodes_data.description: Despite having no claws or fangs to hunt with, Mowgli discovers an effective way in which he can catch his prey.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x3
episodes_data.description: Mowgli is determined to fulfill the wishes of his adoptive father Alexander.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x4
episodes_data.description: Mowgli wonders why his brothers have been inexplicably thrown from their mother's home, and why Akela insists on hunting the weaker prey.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x5
episodes_data.description: Mowgli tries to help Kichi, a young red panda who is new to the jungle.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x6
episodes_data.description: The monkeys use a vulnerable Kichi as bait in an attempt to trap Mowgli.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x7
episodes_data.description: When Baloo loses his patience and slaps Mowgli, the young boy runs away and disregards Baloo's warnings about the "cold fang."

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x8
episodes_data.description: Baloo puts his life at risk in an attempt to rescue Mowgli, who is in serious danger.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x9
episodes_data.description: Mowgli insists on helping his injured wolf-brother Akru, who is being shunned by the other wolves for breaking the law of the pack.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x10
episodes_data.description: An old lone wolf claiming to have been a good friend of Alexander's joins the pack. Meanwhile, food from the emergency reserve is being stolen.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x11
episodes_data.description: Mowgli and Bacchus are accused of stealing from the food reserve, but Bagheera blames the theft on an evil spirit.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x12
episodes_data.description: Mowgli volunteers for a dangerous scouting mission, but little does he know that he is being followed.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x13
episodes_data.description: Vermillion returns after a long absence, and offers to take leadership of the wolf pack when he learns of Alexander's death.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x14
episodes_data.description: The monkeys capture Mowgli, taking him to "The Cold Lair," the ruins of a city once inhabited by humans.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x15
episodes_data.description: While Mowgli is being rescued from Shere Khan and the monkeys, three men arrive to search for buried treasure among the ruins of the ancient city.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x16
episodes_data.description: Mowgli becomes unhappy when some of the wolves blame him for the departure of their new leader, Vermillion.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x17
episodes_data.description: Convinced that his presence is only causing problems in the wolf pack, Mowgli decides to leave.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x18
episodes_data.description: After walking for some time in an unfamiliar area, Mowgli falls into a trap dug in the ground. Meanwhile, Chil the kite has lost track of where Mowgli has gone.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x19
episodes_data.description: A human who has rescued Mowgli continues to ail him to good health, while Bagheera, Baloo and the wolves set out to find Mowgli.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x20
episodes_data.description: Mowgli's mother throws him out of her den, causing him to find a new lair.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x21
episodes_data.description: A drought has hit the jungle, and Hathi the elephant invokes the "water truce," forbidding any animal from hunting at the only remaining water source.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x22
episodes_data.description: Hathi the elephant tells Mowgli and the other animals how fear was first experienced in the jungle by their ancestors long ago.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x23
episodes_data.description: While hunting, Mowgli helps free a deer from a trap instead of taking advantage of its situation and killing it, much to the dismay of the other wolves.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x24
episodes_data.description: Lala, who is usually quite nasty towards Mowgli, suddenly becomes docile.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x25
episodes_data.description: Bunto, a wolf who had been banished by the pack, returns to the jungle and forces Akela to accept his presence.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x26
episodes_data.description: Mowgli and the others learn that Grizzle has been working with Shere Khan.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x27
episodes_data.description: Akela is unwell, and without his guidance the wolf pack is unsuccessful in their hunts.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x28
episodes_data.description: Mowgli and the others learn that Grizzle is still in the jungle, and is planning to usurp Akela's leadership with the help of another wolf.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x29
episodes_data.description: With a plan of attack, Mowgli and the others set out to find Grizzle's hiding place.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x30
episodes_data.description: Mowgli and the others defeat Grizzle, but the wolf pack is still in need of a new leader.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x31
episodes_data.description: Mowgli finds Vermillion and asks him to take Akela's place as leader of the wolf pack.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x32
episodes_data.description: While searching for medicinal plants to treat Bagheera's wounds, Mowgli runs into the man who had saved him from the trap. This time, he has a young girl named Jumeirah with him.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x33
episodes_data.description: Mowgli begins to visit Jumeirah more frequently, who teaches the boy to speak the human language. Meanwhile, Shere Khan has been keeping track of Mowgli's whereabouts.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x34
episodes_data.description: In an attempt to save Jumeirah from Shere Khan, Mowgli engages in a fight with the tiger.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x35
episodes_data.description: Mowgli is very attracted by the lifestyle of his own kind and wants to stay with Jumeirah.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x36
episodes_data.description: Buldeo, the evil hunter of the village, and Ganshum's grandfather, tells his outraged fellow villagers an incredible story: one day, he ventured deep into the jungle and came upon some grey monkeys guarding the secret of eternal youth, who offered him some delicious wine.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x37
episodes_data.description: In order to avenge his wolf father, Alexander, Mowgli is determined to kill Shere Khan with a dagger and the help of his friends, but Chil reports that the tiger has disappeared.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x38
episodes_data.description: Akela's plan of attack against Shere Khan calls on Mowgli to play a decisive role: the boy will be the one who engages the tiger in the final duel. After overcoming much peril, he is to succeed in this endeavor.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x39
episodes_data.description: Mowgli is ordered by Buldeo to bring Shere Khan’s corpse into the village to prove that he has not been lying, and that if he cannot do this, then he will be severely punished.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x40
episodes_data.description: Chil the eagle, warns the animals of the Seeonee forest that a terrible calamity awaits them: an invasion by the dholes, a pack of red dogs pushed northwards by thirst and hunger.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x41
episodes_data.description: The red dogs reach the forest of Seeonee where Mowgli is waiting for them. When the sun goes down, he puts Kaa's plan into action, luring the dogs into Death Valley where a swarm of black bees attacks them.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x42
episodes_data.description: The forest is celebrating the mating season. Mowgli and Bagheera feel left out because all the wolves have found partners.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x43
episodes_data.description: A mongoose called Rikki tells Mowgli that after Buldeo vented his rage on Mowgli's adopted family, that the villagers kidnapped Jumeirah and her parents, believing them to be demons.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x44
episodes_data.description: Mowgli breaks into the hut where Rahhar and his family are held prisoner and sets them free, but they first ask him to provide them with food in order to build up their strength before they make their escape.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x45
episodes_data.description: With the help of the other animals, Mowgli makes it possible for Jumeirah and her family to escape, and, at the same time, manages to scare the villagers so badly that they do not attempt to even follow the fugitives.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x46
episodes_data.description: Everyone is celebrating the birth of Sura and Lala's two cubs, but Mowgli feels homesick for Jumeirah.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x47
episodes_data.description: Mowgli is sold by Riswan to John J. Hargreaves, an intermediary who supplies animals for circuses. During the night, Mowgli manages to escape from the cage he is being held in.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x48
episodes_data.description: Mowgli misses Jumeirah and thinks about her all the time, but he is distracted by the arrival of a herd of deer that is the perfect prey for hungry wolves.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x49
episodes_data.description: Akela is seriously injured in a fight with a pack of hyenas, but instead of taking measures to heal himself, he refuses to eat and won’t accept any form of treatment because he feels his time has come.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x50
episodes_data.description: Hathi brings Mowgli Jumeirah's foulard, and immediately the boy wants to set out to join her, but he doesn't know where she is.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x51
episodes_data.description: Mowgli is reunited with Jumeirah and her family after saving Jumeirah from some rambunctious monkeys, and together they decide to sow the fields again and become stock herders.

episodes_data.title: The Jungle Book: The Adventures of Mowgli 1x52
episodes_data.description: Mowgli decides to leave the jungle, but before going to live in the village with Jumeirah and her family, he bids farewell to all his animal friends, except Bagheera, who will accompany him
